text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — Acme wants SOC2 report excerpt + high-level pen-test summary for the joint marketplace announcement on Thu. They asked for embargoed material handling and a witnessed pen test timeline. Who can own the artifact bundle and the witness slot?
Maya Patel: I can own the evidence bundle prep. Do we have a canonical redaction checklist for marketplace uploads? :thinking_face:
Alex Chen: We have one but it needs a quick sanity check versus Acme's PII guidance. Courtney, can you confirm retention/TTL constraints for their region (EU)?
Courtney Li: EU retention = 180 days for embargoed artifacts, plus we need redaction proof of process. Also need an attestation that no customer data is included. I can sign off on retention side.
Samir Rao: For pen witnessing — I can be available Mon/Tue. We should decide whether we share a summarized findings doc or the full report with redactions. My preference: summary + findings table, full report only via presigned link to SI with explicit ACL and TTL.
Oliver Barnes: From the SI integration side, we need a mapping: which artifacts map to which listing fields (SOC2 -> compliance section, pen -> vuln summary). I'll produce a one-pager mapping.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: Maya = build bundle + run redaction checklist; Samir = arrange witness window and extract summary; Oliver = mapping one-pager; Courtney = retention + signoff. Can we target EOD Wed for final bundle?
Maya Patel: EOD Wed is tight but doable if partners-bot presigns uploads today. Can someone trigger the presign? :pray:
marketplace-bot: presign links ready: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/presign/acme-soc-bundle-3612345678 (ttl=7d)
Maya Patel: Got it, uploading draft now. I'll leave notes in the bundle: what was redacted and why.
Samir Rao: For the witness session, propose Mon 09:30 PT. Tagging legal for witness protocol? (not in thread)
Alex Chen: Mon 09:30 PT works. If legal needs to attend, we'll loop them in. Samir — please prepare a 1-paragraph executive summary for the announcement (non-sensitive).
Samir Rao: Will do, will keep it <= 3 bullets + risk mitigations.
Courtney Li: Once bundle uploaded, I'll verify TTL and document retention in the evidence tracker. Please add the presign URL to the tracker row.
Alex Chen: Perfect. If anything blocks the upload or redaction, flag here or DM Maya. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Noted. Upload in progress.
marketplace-bot: Upload finished by Maya Patel. size=2.4MB, artifacts=[soc-summary.pdf, pen-exec-summary.md, redaction-log.txt]. presign_url=https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/presign/acme-soc-bundle-3612345678
Alex Chen: Excellent — I'll draft a short announcement blurb using Samir's exec summary once it's ready.
